9.5
Steam and Feed Valves
units.display_text: 9.5 Steam and Feed Valves

units.text:
All steam and feedwater connections to boilers are to have stop valves connected directly to the
boilers.

possible.

units.text:
The stop valves are to be arranged to close against boiler pressure, except the stop valves
on feedwater connections may close against feed water pressure.
units.display_text: The stop valves are to be arranged to close against boiler pressure, except the stop valves on feedwater connections may close against feed water pressure.

source_spans.text: The stop valves are to be arranged to close against boiler pressure, except the stop valves
on feedwater connections may close against feed water pressure.

units.text:
Screw down valves are to close
with a clockwise motion of the hand when facing the top of the stem.
units.display_text: Screw down valves are to close with a clockwise motion of the hand when facing the top of the stem.

source_spans.text: Screw down valves are to close
with a clockwise motion of the hand when facing the top of the stem.

units.text: One steam stop valve is to be fitted to each steam outlet from a propulsion or auxiliary boiler.
units.display_text: One steam stop valve is to be fitted to each steam outlet from a propulsion or auxiliary boiler.

source_spans.text: One steam stop valve is to be fitted to each steam outlet from a propulsion or auxiliary boiler.

units.text:
Where a superheater is fitted, the steam stop valve is to be located at the superheater to insure a
flow of steam through the superheater at all times, except that where the total superheat
temperature is low, alternative arrangement may be considered.
units.display_text: Where a superheater is fitted, the steam stop valve is to be located at the superheater to insure a flow of steam through the superheater at all times, except that where the total superheat temperature is low, alternative arrangement may be considered.

source_spans.text: Where a superheater is fitted, the steam stop valve is to be located at the superheater to insure a
flow of steam through the superheater at all times, except that where the total superheat
temperature is low, alternative arrangement may be considered.

units.text:
Each steam stop valve exceeding
150 mm (6 in.) nominal diameter is to be fitted with a by-pass valve for plant warm-up purposes.
units.display_text: Each steam stop valve exceeding 150 mm (6 in.) nominal diameter is to be fitted with a by-pass valve for plant warm-up purposes.

source_spans.text: 150 mm (6 in.) nominal diameter is to be fitted with a by-pass valve for plant warm-up purposes.

units.text: Where two or more boilers are connected, the steam stop valve is to be of the non-return type.
units.display_text: Where two or more boilers are connected, the steam stop valve is to be of the non-return type.

source_spans.text: Where two or more boilers are connected, the steam stop valve is to be of the non-return type.

units.text:
In
addition, the steam outlet connecting pipe from each boiler is to be provided with an additional
shut off valve located in series and downstream of the required steam stop valve.

units.text:
For boilers with a design pressure of 27.6 bar (28 kgf/cm2, 400
psi) or over, the feed-water connection to the drum is to be fitted with a sleeve or other suitable
device to reduce the effects of metal temperature differentials between the feed pipe and the shell
or head of the drum.

units.text:
Feed water is not to be discharged into a boiler in such a manner that it impinges directly against
surfaces exposed to hot gases or the radiant heat of the fire.

units.text: 9.5.3(b) Feed stop valve.
units.display_text: 9.5.3(b) Feed stop valve.

units.text:
A feed stop valve is to be fitted to each feedwater line to the boiler and is
to be attached directly to the boiler.
units.display_text: A feed stop valve is to be fitted to each feedwater line to the boiler and is to be attached directly to the boiler.

source_spans.text: A feed stop valve is to be fitted to each feedwater line to the boiler and is
to be attached directly to the boiler.

units.text:
If an economizer forms a part of the boiler, the feedwater stop
valve may be attached directly on the economizer.
units.display_text: If an economizer forms a part of the boiler, the feedwater stop valve may be attached directly on the economizer.

source_spans.text: If an economizer forms a part of the boiler, the feedwater stop
valve may be attached directly on the economizer.

units.text:
Consideration will be given to locating the
valve near an operating platform provided that the pipe between the economizer and the valve is a
seamless steel pipe having all joints welded.
